portal_description:
The ipsilon packages provide the Ipsilon identity provider service for federated single sign-on (SSO). Ipsilon links authentication providers and applications or utilities to allow for SSO. It includes a server and utilities to configure Apache-based service providers.

This enhancement update adds the ipsilon packages to Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7. Ipsilon is introduced in this release as a Technology Preview. Customers are advised not to consider integration of this service for production environments at this time. (BZ#1205349)

All users who require ipsilon are advised to install these new packages.

abstract:
The ipsilon packages provide the Ipsilon identity provider service for federated single sign-on (SSO). Ipsilon links authentication providers and applications or utilities to allow for SSO. It includes a server and utilities to configure Apache-based service providers.

This enhancement update adds the ipsilon packages to Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7. Ipsilon is introduced in this release as a Technology Preview. Customers are advised not to consider integration of this service for production environments at this time. (BZ#1205349)

All users who require ipsilon are advised to install these new packages.
